Use {{name}} placeholders for arguments. In the URL they are URL-encoded; in the body they become JSON values. The secret is stored encrypted and sent in the header you name.
A custom tool is a small Python script (run in Termux) or an HTTP request. The AI sees its name, description and parameters. Arguments are validated against the schema before every call.
Runs with python3 in Termux. Arguments arrive as JSON on stdin; print plain text or JSON {\"status\", \"message\", \"data\"}.

No employees yet, so the boss works alone.
Off: kept, but the boss will not delegate to them

Each employee gets the task brief from the boss, works with its own model and only the tools you allow, and sends back a report. Every action still needs the same permissions and approvals as the boss. Watch who is doing what in the Agent screen\'s team tree.
How this employee should work (style, checks, what to report)

Your companion is the boss. Employees are helper agents you create, each with its own AI provider. The boss checks the team for every task: if someone\'s role fits, it hands the work over and reviews the report; otherwise it does the work itself.
Another employee already has this name
Employees cannot create other employees or schedule tasks. API keys stay encrypted in the provider settings.
Termux is not available, so no runtimes could be checked.
Private terminal. Each command runs as its own process; full-screen programs like vim are not supported. Type clear to clear.
Termux is not installed. Install Termux from F-Droid or GitHub (the Play Store version is outdated), then come back.

In Termux run:

mkdir -p ~/.termux && echo "allow-external-apps=true" >> ~/.termux/termux.properties

then restart Termux and grant Your Friend the "Run commands in Termux" permission.
Tools the AI can call. Unavailable tools are hidden from the AI until their requirement is met.

OmniVoice clones a voice from a short clean recording (ref.wav, 3–10 s) and its exact transcript (ref.txt).
Use an omnivoice-server running on your PC, a home server or in Termux. Clone mode sends ref.wav and ref.txt with each request.

Speaks through your Gradio Space (for example Suvo75/tanu-voice running OmniVoice with your ref.wav). The text of each reply is sent to that Space.

A Hugging Face token makes ZeroGPU use your own account\'s daily quota (bigger when logged in, bigger again with PRO) and is needed for private Spaces. It is not unlimited. A sleeping Space takes 1–2 minutes to wake up.
More steps sound better but take longer. 16–32 is a good range on phones.
No speech recognition service is installed, so voice input is unavailable.
Uses the text-to-speech engine installed on Android. It cannot clone voices.
Hi, I\'m %1$s. This is how I sound.
None — every sentence is a command

Separate with commas, e.g. tanu, hey tanu, hi alex. Only sentences containing one of them are sent; the command is what you say after it. Say just the wake word and you have 8 seconds for the request. Add the spelling your recognizer writes too (e.g. তনু or तनु for Bengali/Hindi).

Not downloaded (~%1$d MB). Tap to download. With it only the wake word is listened for, offline, even when you speak quietly; the rest is recorded after it.

Ready ✓ — set a wake word below to use it. Tap to remove.

Hands-free works best with the offline wake word engine (~%1$d MB, downloaded once). It only listens for your wake word — nothing is recorded or sent until you say it. Without it, every sentence goes to the speech recognizer.
Higher hears quiet or unclear speech but triggers on similar words more often.
